author: Reuters
content_snippet:
Nvidia's board has reinstated Jensen Huang as president and CEO, six days after its chair said directors did not intend to bring him back.

The board voted unanimously to reinstate Huang as president, CEO and a board member, effective immediately, the company said on Monday. It followed "a series of discussions and meetings" with Huang, after which the board was satisfied with his "candor and ability to lead" the firm.

author: Reuters
content_snippet:
WASHINGTON, Nov 23 (Reuters) - US lawmakers from both parties offered sharp criticism on Monday of Nvidia's decision to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO and said Congress must pass legislation to crack down on US chip exports to China and get answers.

Democratic Senator Elizabeth Warren, who is set to chair the Banking Committee starting in January, called the decision to reinstate Huang "reckless," adding the board still owes Congress answers about the company's compliance with US export controls

title_en: Why using rocks for carbon removal could eventually reduce crop growth
author: James Temple
content_snippet:
Tech companies are investing a lot of hope and money in rocks.

Google, Microsoft, and others have committed hundreds of millions of dollars to get startups to spread crushed basalt, olivine, or other alkaline materials across farms, in an effort to capture carbon from the air and lock it away. summary_en: Research by CarbonPlan suggests that 'Enhanced Rock Weathering' (ERW), a climate solution heavily backed by Google and Microsoft, faces significant scalability challenges. The study indicates that spreading basalt or olivine at levels required for climate impact may degrade soil health and decrease crop yields; scaling back applications to protect harvests would likely cap the method's CO2 removal potential to under 1 billion tons per year.

summary_en: Edmund McMillen and Nicalis, Inc. integrated AI-generated music containing Suno metadata into 'The Binding of Isaac: Repentance Plus', violating Valve's mandatory disclosure policy for generative AI and triggering a review-bombing campaign on Steam. author: Jonathan Kemper
content_snippet:
AI coding agents are nearing top scores on standard benchmarks. A new experiment puts them to work for the first time as digital employees inside a simulated software company with colleagues, project boards, and chat histories. Even Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra fully complete fewer than one in ten tasks.

summary_en: In a simulated software development environment featuring project boards, chat logs, and collaborative workflows, leading models like GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 achieved a task completion rate of less than 10%. The findings highlight a critical performance gap between high scores on isolated code benchmarks and the requirements of complex, collaborative system engineering.

Perplexity says that approach becomes nearly impossible to maintain across hundreds of topics and pages.

The API has two modes. We
summary_en: Perplexity has launched the Monitor API, allowing developers to define monitoring goals via natural language for periodic scanning of specific web pages or global information. author: Matthias Bastian
content_snippet:
Security researchers at Dragos sent roughly 2 million AI requests containing fake credentials to AI providers and uncovered major security flaws.

The researchers ran the tests from July through November 2026 and identified at least three compromised providers where attackers were actively stealing user data. None of the three knew they had been compromised until Dragos notified them.

Attackers in the largest incident harvested hundreds of AWS keys, including some from requests the provider had
summary_en: Security firm Dragos revealed between July and November 2026 that multiple AI inference providers failed to uphold data retention policies, leading to the theft of AWS keys and sensitive user requests. Investigations confirmed that some marketplace resellers enabled logging to intercept data, with instances of leaked test URLs being accessed within minutes from Beijing and Shanghai via internal communication platforms.
subheadings: Intermediaries are the weak link
title_zh: AI推理平台安全漏洞致用户密钥遭大规模窃取
summary_zh: 安全机构Dragos通过模拟测试发现，多家AI推理代理商存在严重的隐私泄露与密钥窃取漏洞，导致用户凭证遭到非法访问与持久化攻击

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 安全研究机构Dragos在2026年7月至11月期间，通过投喂200万条虚假凭证测试发现，多家AI推理服务提供商未能履行数据留存协议，导致AWS密钥、用户请求内容遭到非法窃取。调查显示，部分中间商恶意开启日志记录功能，甚至出现数据泄露至外部聊天平台（如飞书）并在北京、上海等地被迅速访问的极端案例。

Investigations confirmed that some marketplace resellers enabled logging to intercept data, with instances of leaked test URLs being accessed within minutes from Beijing and Shanghai via internal communication platforms.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】安全机构Dragos、AI路由服务商OpenRouter、推理平台Novita、Phala、Together及部分未公开第三方在全球性AI模型推理调用API接口及在线算力市场：通过向代理商投喂诱饵数据，揭露了攻击者窃取API密钥、滥用零数据留存政策以及利用内部日志泄露敏感信息的行为
【起因与机理】AI推理市场缺乏统一的端到端加密与安全合规标准，中间商为压低价格牺牲了数据隔离与安全合规性

[Root Cause & Mechanism] Lack of standardized end-to-end encryption in the fragmented AI inference supply chain and excessive cost-cutting by marketplace resellers

title: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol get to the point faster but score lower on transparency than Claude

author: Tomislav Bezmalinović
content_snippet:
An Artificial Analysis evaluation shows how much OpenAI's communication style has changed. A comparison with Anthropic reveals sharp differences.

OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol give much shorter answers, get to the point faster, and impose less structure on their responses than their predecessors. At the same time, Artificial Analysis rates their tendency to admit uncertainty much lower.

Astra's average answer length dropped from 352 to 210 words, a 40 percent decrease. Sol went from 337 to 22
summary_en: OpenAI's latest GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol models have shifted towards high-efficiency interaction in Artificial Analysis benchmarks, reducing average response lengths by 40% and 34% respectively. By deprioritizing structured formatting and uncertainty disclosure, these models achieve faster direct answers, whereas Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 and Opus 5.5 maintain superior performance in transparency and organizational indices.

Personality scores reflect style, not accuracy

author: Chris Buckley and Julian E. Barnes
content_snippet:
When China’s top espionage agency updated its priorities this year, it added a revealing goal: overcoming Western barriers to technologies that Xi Jinping sees as crucial to China’s rise.

At the heart of that quest are the advanced semiconductors needed to power artificial intelligence, including chips that the United States has barred U.S. companies like Nvidia from exporting to China.

China must “adopt extraordinary measures to intensify the drive for core technologies in priority sectors,”
summary_en: China's Ministry of State Security, led by Minister Chen Yixin, has established a specialized task force reporting directly to him to bypass U.S. semiconductor export restrictions. The unit focuses on illicit procurement of restricted high-end Nvidia AI chips and intelligence gathering on key chip executives to counter Western technological blockades.

title: Perplexity and Intelligence
title_en: Perplexity and Intelligence
author: OpenAI
content_snippet:
By Jakub Pachocki, Chief Scientist at OpenAI

From afar, it might seem like modern AI is built similarly to how software has been built in previous decades: with a diverse set of techniques targeting specific capabilities. There are indeed a variety of methods, but rather than designing something from scratch, they are mostly harnessing the intelligence coming from a much simpler and less interpretable process: training a compressor (or, equivalently, predictor) on a very large corpus of data. 1
summary_en: Jakub Pachocki, Chief Scientist at OpenAI, advocates for establishing perplexity as the primary metric for comparing model developers' pretraining progress and safety standards. This move aims to standardize scientific measurement across the industry by increasing transparency in model performance.

title: Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end
title_en: Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end
author: Jonathan Kemper
content_snippet:
Language models can now process entire novels at once. An Nvidia research team says that's often overkill and expensive. In many tests, periodic summaries and targeted lookups worked about as well.

A language model's context window is its working memory, covering everything it holds in view when generating a reply. Over the past few years, that window has grown rapidly. GPT-4 launched in March 2023 with 8,192 tokens. Today, GPT 5.6 Sol handles around one million tokens, about 120 times as much
summary_en: Nvidia researchers demonstrated that blindly scaling context windows to million-token levels is not the optimal path for LLM efficiency. Their findings indicate that combining periodic summarization with targeted information retrieval achieves comparable performance while significantly reducing computational costs and inference latency.

Publicly, the group known as Maple promises to save humanity from an AI apocalypse. Behind closed doors, former members say, it records every breath its residents take to build an AI god modeled on its leader's mind. That promise of salvation holds particular appeal for the people who build AI and the infrastructure behind it.

author: Sui-Lee Wee and Li You
content_snippet:
As the United States and China vie for artificial intelligence supremacy, Chinese tech companies are facing a mounting challenge: finding the money to keep up.

Like their American rivals, China’s A.I. start-ups face soaring costs to train increasingly powerful models. But while Anthropic raised more than $80 billion in a record-breaking initial public offering this week, its Chinese competitors face a far more unforgiving financial landscape.

Venture capital investment in China lags far behind
summary_en: Chinese tech giants and AI startups are facing severe capital expenditure pressure, with total spending projected to reach $139 billion this year while AI-related revenue covers less than 8%. Beyond U.S. export controls on advanced chips, new regulations are closing loopholes involving Southeast Asian data centers, further exacerbating the mismatch between high CAPEX and insufficient commercial returns.

title: OpenAI shares new prompting tips for GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol to fix brief answers and unnecessary questions

author: Jonathan Kemper

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 谷歌近期在科罗拉多州增设实验室，旨在并行推进超导量子位与另一新兴量子计算路径，以应对量子纠错这一核心技术瓶颈。此举不仅是对既有超导路线的策略性对冲，亦反映出在面对亚马逊、IBM及微软等竞争对手及全球资金角逐时，谷歌正加速从学术探索转向工程交付的阶段。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Google has opened a new lab in Colorado to develop alternative quantum computing architectures alongside its existing superconducting qubit program to solve the critical error correction bottleneck. This strategic hedging reflects the escalating race against industry rivals like Amazon, IBM, and Microsoft as the competition shifts from theoretical milestones to practical engineering deployment.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】谷歌（Google）量子实验室、Hartmut Neven（谷歌物理学家）：开发超导量子位以外的并行技术路径，强化量子纠错能力
【起因与机理】超导路径仍面临纠错难题，且全球范围内商业与政府资金激增导致赛道进入白热化阶段
【核心事实细节】谷歌策略重心从超导单一路线转向并行技术储备。
【各方立场与态度】全球科技巨头及各国政府正进入量子计算领域的高强度资金投入期。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Google Quantum Lab, Hartmut Neven (Physicist): Developing parallel quantum architectures beyond superconducting qubits to address error correction
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Unresolved error correction bottlenecks and intensified global commercial and state-level competition
[Key Metrics] In May, after China vowed to pump more than $15.
[Key Position & Outlook] Global capital influx marks the onset of an intensive commercialization race.

title: NYU's Tristan Buckmaster and Anthropic's Levent Alpöge publish an AI-aided proof of Navier-Stokes blowup, saying it closes a loophole in OpenAI's solution (Peter Hall/Scientific American)
title_en: NYU's Tristan Buckmaster and Anthropic's Levent Alpöge publish an AI-aided proof of Navier-Stokes blowup, saying it closes a loophole in OpenAI's solution (Peter Hall/Scientific American)

inline_images.caption: A visual representation of fluid dynamics. Researchers from New York University and Anthropic claimed to have solved the “real” version of the Navier-Stokes equ
inline_images.alt: A visual representation of fluid dynamics. Researchers from New York University and Anthropic claime

author: Scientific American
content_snippet:
Two months after getting scooped by OpenAI, N.Y.U. professor Tristan Buckmaster and Anthropic employee Levent Alpöge are back with a new AI-aided proof of Navier-Stokes blowup

It looks like Anthropic employee Levent Alpöge was not satisfied with one blockbuster math proof today. Right after Alpöge’s announcement of a claimed proof of the Riemann hypothesis—math’s most famed open problem—has come the news that he and New York University professor Tristan Buckmaster believe they have closed a con
summary_en: NYU Professor Tristan Buckmaster and Anthropic researcher Levent Alpöge released an AI-aided proof addressing the infinite fluid velocity paradox in the Navier-Stokes equations. This work aims to close the loophole in OpenAI's September solution, which was criticized for relying on unrealistic external forces, and addresses prior tensions over intellectual property and competitive timing.
title_zh: 纳维-斯托克斯方程解法争议升级
summary_zh: 纽约大学教授Buckmaster与Anthropic研究员Alpöge发布AI辅助证明，旨在修复OpenAI此前被指存在逻辑漏洞的流体力学解法

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 纽约大学教授Tristan Buckmaster与Anthropic研究员Levent Alpöge共同发布了一项AI辅助证明，宣称解决了纳维-斯托克斯方程（Navier-Stokes equations）流体速度无限大的物理悖论。该工作旨在弥补OpenAI于9月提出方案中关于“人为设定极端外部力”的逻辑缺陷，并回应了此前关于OpenAI抢发成果及潜在数据挪用的学术竞争争议。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: NYU Professor Tristan Buckmaster and Anthropic researcher Levent Alpöge released an AI-aided proof addressing the infinite fluid velocity paradox in the Navier-Stokes equations. This work aims to close the loophole in OpenAI's September solution, which was criticized for relying on unrealistic external forces, and addresses prior tensions over intellectual property and competitive timing.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】Tristan Buckmaster（纽约大学教授）、Levent Alpöge（Anthropic研究员）：发布AI辅助证明以修正OpenAI关于纳维-斯托克斯方程解法的逻辑漏洞
【起因与机理】针对OpenAI此前方案的物理可行性争议及学术界对数据竞争的担忧
【核心事实细节】研究者挑战OpenAI此前关于流体动力学解法的数学完备性。
【各方立场与态度】AI作为证明辅助工具的使用正导致科研领域发布周期与验证标准发生剧烈重构。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Tristan Buckmaster (NYU Professor) and Levent Alpöge (Anthropic researcher): Published an AI-aided proof to address logical loopholes in OpenAI's Navier-Stokes solution
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Addressing controversies over the physical validity of OpenAI's previous method and competitive data practices
[Key Fact Detail] Challenging the mathematical completeness of OpenAI's previous fluid dynamics solution.
[Key Position & Outlook] AI-assisted proofs are forcing a rapid re-evaluation of publication and validation standards in high-stakes research.

title: Microsoft plans to retire its To Do app on June 30, 2027, offering migration to Planner for work and school accounts, but no replacement for personal accounts (Todd Bishop/GeekWire)
title_en: Microsoft plans to retire its To Do app on June 30, 2027, offering migration to Planner for work and school accounts, but no replacement for personal accounts (Todd Bishop/GeekWire)
author: GeekWire
content_snippet:
Microsoft acquired the popular Wunderlist app in 2015, shut it down in 2020 and told its loyal users that Microsoft To Do would be their new home. Now they’re being asked to pack up again.

Microsoft plans to retire the To Do apps on June 30, 2027, moving personal task management for work and school accounts into Planner, its team project-management app. Microsoft disclosed the change Wednesday in a long Planner blog post amid the company’s Ignite announcements, and Windows Latest flagged the ch
summary_en: Microsoft announced the retirement of the To Do app effective June 30, 2027. Work and school accounts will transition tasks to Planner, while personal account users currently lack a replacement strategy, raising concerns over data migration and feature parity.

ai_analysis.briefing_en: Microsoft announced the retirement of the To Do app effective June 30, 2027. Work and school accounts will transition tasks to Planner, while personal account users currently lack a replacement strategy, raising concerns over data migration and feature parity.

Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., the world's largest contract chipmaker, has put shipments to several Chinese and non-Chinese chip developers on hold as it
summary_en: The U.S. Department of Commerce has expanded export controls to include chips produced at or below the 14/16nm process node, affecting mobile SoCs, automotive, and consumer electronics chips. fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】美国商务部、台积电、小米及各类消费电子与自动驾驶芯片设计商：出口管制门槛降至14/16纳米，暂停交付非白名单客户的消费级芯片

fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] U.S. Department of Commerce, TSMC, Xiaomi, and various consumer/automotive chip developers: Reduced export control threshold to 14/16nm nodes and suspended shipments to non-whitelisted entities
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To restrict access to advanced process nodes and curb the development of domestic high-end computing capabilities globally
[Key Metrics] Export control threshold lowered from AI-specific chips to all 14/16nm nodes.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Supply chain impact spreads from AI data centers to smartphone and automotive sectors.

Ubisoft said the subsidiary is currently focused on developing "smart NPCs with memory and AI game masters that manage large-scale systemic worlds."

summary_en: Ubisoft has launched its subsidiary Motherbrain, integrating the generative AI team behind the Teammates project to develop smart NPCs with long-term memory and autonomous systemic world-management engines. The subsidiary intends to provide technical support for internal Creative House workflows while seeking external strategic partnerships.

title_zh: 美国多地警方借GTA VI热度进行AI征兵营销
summary_zh: 美国加州、华盛顿州及加拿大等地警方利用《GTA VI》发行热度，通过AI生成带有游戏风格的征兵广告进行招募

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 近期随着《侠盗猎车手6》（GTA VI）正式发售，圣地亚哥警察局（SDPD）及华盛顿州、加拿大等地的执法部门在Instagram等平台发布大量AI生成的同风格图像，以此诱导受众应聘警务职位。此举试图利用游戏引发的文化共鸣，将执法职业伪装成现实版的“任务挑战”进行社会宣传。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Following the release of Grand Theft Auto VI, police departments including the San Diego Police Department (SDPD) and agencies in Washington and Canada are utilizing AI-generated imagery mimicking the game’s aesthetic for recruitment campaigns. These departments are attempting to leverage the title's cultural dominance to rebrand police careers as real-world equivalents of the game's high-stakes missions.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】圣地亚哥警察局(SDPD)及华盛顿州与加拿大各地方警察机构在Instagram及各大社交媒体平台：发布AI生成的类GTA游戏风格广告，推销警务岗位
【起因与机理】利用现象级游戏热度触达年轻群体，提升招募吸引力
【核心事实细节】执法机构利用现象级游戏IP开展社交媒体招聘。
【各方立场与态度】公权力机构与反权威叙事游戏的营销绑定引发品牌认知争议。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] San Diego Police Department (SDPD) and regional police agencies in Washington and Canada: Posting AI-generated, GTA-themed recruitment ads for police positions
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Capitalizing on the game's cultural mania to engage younger demographics for recruitment
[Key Fact Detail] Law enforcement agencies leveraging viral gaming IP for social media recruitment.
[Key Position & Outlook] Conflict between public authority branding and anti-establishment gaming narratives.
